SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
I.O. CHINESE SECTION Station,
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. I. D. REGIST. I. O. D. 95）
Date March 18th 1929

Subject (in full) Indecent Publications.

Made by C.D.I. Prince Forwarded by [签名] A.C. Pol.

Reference to the attached I have submitted the
publications referred to to Mr. Bryan P. A. also Messrs Kum.
and Ru, his assistants, and they are all of the opinion that
Court action could taken against the Editor, but Mr. Bryan
is of the opinion that in view of judgement given in a previous
action against the same paper for similar publications, "please
see attached file", it is doubtful whether action in this case
would be successful. Mr. Bryan also informed me that unless
action was taken by the Police as a matter of principle he
did not think it worth while taking any action, as the publi-
cations are claimed to be copies of pictures published in a
German book, and as to whether they are really indecent publi-
cations or not it is a matter of personal opinion.

（批：File / no action / 19/3. [签名]）
A.C.P. Pol'.
A/269.
（批：I recommend that / no action be taken. [签名] [签名] / C.D.I. / 18:3:29.）
（左侧边缘批注：See S.O. / 9597.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
情报处华务股分站，
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事侦缉处登记室 情报处 D. 95）
日期：1929年3月18日

事由（全称）：淫秽出版物。

呈报人：刑事侦缉督察 Prince 转呈人 [签名] 助理警司

关于附件所述事项，我已将所涉出版物提交给布莱恩先生（P. A. Bryan），以及他的助手金先生（Kum）和鲁先生（Ru）。他们均认为可以对编辑提起诉讼，但布莱恩先生认为，鉴于此前因类似出版物对同一报纸采取的诉讼行动之判决结果（“请参阅附件卷宗”），本案诉讼能否成功尚存疑问。布莱恩先生还告知我，除非警方出于原则性考虑采取行动，否则他认为不值得采取任何行动，因为这些出版物声称是复制自一本德国书籍中的图片，至于它们是否确属淫秽出版物，则属于个人见解问题。

（批注：归档 / 不采取行动 / 19/3. [签名]）
助理警司
A/269.
（批注：我建议 / 不采取行动。[签名] [签名] / 刑事侦缉督察 / 1929年3月18日。）
（左侧边缘批注：见特别办公室 / 9597。）

No. 3
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
V.I.O. Gordon Rd. Station.
No. I. O. D. 92.
Date....................
Date March 11th 1929
Subject (in full) Indecent Publication.
Made by Inspector Long. Forwarded by
Sir,
I respectfully beg to forward herewith copies of the
"Shanghai Sketch" for January 5th and 19th last, which were handed
to me for perusal in a Dentists waiting room this afternoon: it
appears that the Publication is making a deliberate attempt therein
to bring foreigners into ridicule and contempt; British, French,
Italian and Manchurian women being portrayed.
It appears to be a case where some action is necessary
by the authorities.
I am,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.C.P.
Inspector.
（批：AC (illegible) Chinese Section, For investigation and necessary action. JLL 12/3/29）

报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
戈登路分站情报官
情报处编号 D. 92.
日期....................
日期：1929年3月11日
事由（全称）：淫秽出版物。
呈报人：龙巡长（Inspector Long）。转呈人

先生，
谨此呈上去年1月5日和19日出版的《上海素描》（Shanghai Sketch）副本，这些刊物是今天下午我在一家牙医诊所的候诊室中拿到并阅读的：该出版物似乎故意试图在其中嘲弄和蔑视外国人；其中描绘了英国、法国、意大利和满洲女性。
这似乎是一个当局需要采取某种行动的案件。
此致，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
副警司
巡长
（批注：交华务股助理警司（字迹不清），进行调查及采取必要行动。JLL 1929年3月12日）
